# ui::ShadowRecipe

Header: `winui/render/OverlayShadow.hpp`.

The two superimposed black shadows that make up a drop shadow: an omnidirectional `ambient` and a downward-offset `directional`. Both are pure black, and only their alpha varies. Blur and offsets are in DIPs, alphas 0..1. Anything below Z 4 casts nothing, which is why a Fluent button has no shadow.

Example: 
```cpp
// A card-like Border at Z = 8, drawn under its own background.
const ui::Rect         bounds{16, 16, 240, 120};
const ui::Color        card_background = ui::colors::White;
const ui::ShadowRecipe recipe = ui::ShadowRecipe::for_elevation(ui::elevation_z::Card, theme.dark);
if (recipe.casts())
{
    ui::draw_drop_shadow(renderer, bounds, 8.0f, recipe);
}
renderer.fill_rounded_rect(bounds, 8.0f, card_background);
```

## ambient_blur

```cpp
float ambient_blur = 0.0f
```

Blur radius of the ambient shadow.

## ambient_y

```cpp
float ambient_y = 0.0f
```

Downward offset of the ambient shadow.

## ambient_alpha

```cpp
float ambient_alpha = 0.0f
```

Opacity of the ambient shadow; 0 draws none.

## directional_blur

```cpp
float directional_blur = 0.0f
```

Blur radius of the directional (key-light) shadow.

## directional_y

```cpp
float directional_y = 0.0f
```

Downward offset of the directional shadow.

## directional_alpha

```cpp
float directional_alpha = 0.0f
```

Opacity of the directional shadow; 0 draws none.

## casts

```cpp
bool casts() const
```

Whether either shadow is visible at all.

## for_elevation

```cpp
static ShadowRecipe for_elevation(float elevation, bool dark)
```

The drop-shadow recipe for elevation `elevation`, with the alphas for a light or `dark` theme. A dark theme's alphas are roughly double. Up to Z 32 there is no ambient shadow. In a light theme the directional alpha stops growing at Z 16, so a [ToolTip](../controls/tool-tip.md#uitooltip) and a [Flyout](../controls/flyout.md#uiflyout) have the same opacity and differ only in blur and offset. A dark theme uses a flat 0.26 up to Z 32.
